lesson: artifact.managedGraph answers a file that is not its format with supported:false and a stated reason, never by throwing, and the SHA-256 it reports is the digest of exactly the bytes the fixture wrote — compared against a value computed independently, so it cannot be the hash of a different or partial read. It returns every key it declares even when it could parse nothing, so a caller never branches on whether a key is present, and it marks the result untrusted because bytes from a file are evidence about that file and nothing more.
